description: Baugher: noted on display at American Legion Post 27 in Middlebury Vermont in September 2011 on loan from the National Naval Aviation Museum after service with VT-23 VT-24 TW-3 and TW-1. An OSM historic=aircraft node in the current extract fixes it at 44.00094 -73.14725 - good currency. Aerial Visuals lists the site simply as "American Legion".
